newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway debt static in uncertain pre-election mood.
newsitem.headline: Norway debt static in uncertain pre-election mood.

text.p: 1400 GMT -- Norwegian long bond yields and short rates were little changed in low activity.

Dealers said the market was expected to remain quiet with many investors sidelined due to a lack of domestic and international economic data and also to continuing nervousness ahead of Norway's election in September.

"The risk of a different government being in place after the general election is likely to result in some weakness on the bond and currency markets, with the centrist parties in particular in favour of higher spending," said Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in a monthly report.
"This would only add to concern that the economy is growing too strongly to keep inflation at bay. However, a Labour win would be received positively by the markets.
* 2007 bond yield one basis point lower at 6.11 pct
* Norway over Bunds gap two basis points wider at 46 points
* Three-month eurokrone one basis point lower at 4.06 pct
* Crown 102.81 vs inverse European Currency Unit index vs 102.76
